content_of_post_to_answer: I want to do something better, but how can I do it easily? I always do some work, but what field?
answer: The hidden difficulty in this question is the assumption that there is one perfect field waiting to be discovered. Most people find direction after they start exploring, not before. Try small experiments: learn a skill, help someone, take a short project, observe what problems you enjoy solving. A career choice is rarely a moment of clarity; it is usually the result of repeated feedback. The field becomes clearer when you stop searching for the right path and start collecting evidence about yourself.
